instruction.name: AGENTS.md
instruction.note: The body of an agent's AGENTS.md is its instruction.

skill.name: Skills
skill.note: An import from GitHub omits files over 1 MiB, past 9,990 files or 61 MiB per repository, and files its execution or secret-disclosure checks reject; unsafe content, secrets and invalid paths are rejected.

hook.name: Hooks

codex-plugin.note: Claude Code's plugin docs name only the .claude-plugin/plugin.json manifest.

hook.name: Hooks
hook.note: Configured in hooks.json or config.toml under .codex/.

claude-code-plugin.note: OpenAI says it accepts Claude-compatible plugin manifests, but neither this page nor its guide to submitting a Claude Code plugin says Codex loads a plugin whose only manifest is .claude-plugin/plugin.json. That guide covers OpenAI's plugin directory: the author removes lifecycle hooks, and the portal converts the manifest to .codex-plugin/plugin.json on upload.

codex-plugin.name: Plugins
codex-plugin.note: A root plugin.json, with .codex-plugin/plugin.json still read as a fallback.
